example_raw: 2  sweet potatoes, cut into match sticks
1/4 cup all-purpose (or gluten free all-purpose flour)

ingredient_name: green onions or handful of chives )
example_raw: 2   green onions or handful of chives (chopped (chives for low fodmap))
4 cups mixed chopped vegetables  ((we used red bell pepper, broccoli, carrots & kale))
1 tablespoon liquid smoke  ((you can find this in almost any grocery store))
1 cup marinara sauce (sugar free, for Whole30)
2 cups chopped or thinly sliced carrots
Thinly sliced green onions for garnish
2-3  NY strip steaks (or other steak), 1 inch thick
4 cups little gems ((from 2 small heads) washed and rough chopped)
1 tbsp sweet chilli sauce (store bought or homemade)

ingredient_name: pound of potatoes, thin-skinned, 1/8 inch rounds
example_raw: 1 pound of potatoes, thin-skinned, sliced 1/8 inch rounds (potatoes are optional)
1 tablespoon chili crisp (or 30 minute chili oil)
1 (4 oz) can can mild green chilies ((undrained))
1-2 large leeks, sliced into ½ inch thick rounds ( if dirty, rinse, see notes)
3 cups of mixed vegetables (such as broccoli, asparagus, bell pepper, mushrooms)
¼  cup unsweetened shaved coconut flakes

ingredient_name: teaspoon chili flakes or urfa biber
example_raw: 1/4 teaspoon chili flakes or urfa biber
3 cups roughly chopped carrots and parsnips (optional)
2 cups diced ripe peaches or nectarines (about 3)
2 pounds of ripe tomatoes, chopped (or use a 28-ounce can of tomato puree or crushed tomatoes - see notes below)

ingredient_name: leeks, white parts only, split, washed
example_raw: 2 leeks, white parts only, split, thinly sliced, and washed
1/2 tablespoon sambal oelek (or Sriracha, (optional, for heat))
3 medium carrots, peeled and cut into very thin rounds

ingredient_name: thai bird chilies or holland chilies
example_raw: 3  Thai bird chilies or holland chilies
2  jalapeños, chopped, and seeded if desired
1/2 tsp chili flakes ((Add more, to taste, depending on your heat preference))
6  green onions (sliced into 1.5-inch pieces (white and green parts))
8  tostada shells ((store-bought or homemade using corn tortillas - see notes))
1 lb carrots (5 medium), peeled and chopped into 2-inch pieces
½ lb beets (3 medium/4 small) peeled and chopped into 1-inch wedges

ingredient_name: cup mixed herbs, , plus for garnish
example_raw: 1 cup mixed herbs, packed (I used parsley, dill & basil), plus extra for garnish

ingredient_name: to 2 tablespoons sambal olek, depending on your heat tolerance
example_raw: 1 to 2 tablespoons sambal olek, depending on your heat tolerance
1/2 large jalapeno, stem and seed removed, diced (optional)
1/4-1/2 cup chopped herbs (mint, dill, Italian parsley or cilantro- a mix is nice)
3/4 cup fresh herbs (cilantro, Italian parsley, dill or basil or a combo!)
